utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I appreciate you asking, but I've got some personal things to handle this weekend.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Alright, understood. I'll still be there Saturday at 9.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Okay, hope it goes well.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Kira! I've been gathering supplies for the repair drive this weekend. Are you planning to join us?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: A repair drive? Are you sure you heard that right?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, sorry! It's a neighborhood event this weekend to fix up the community center. I thought you might have heard about it from Vik or Rosa.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Rosa, are you interested in the repair drive we're organizing?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh absolutely, Sam! I've been coordinating it—just a heads up, I had to move it to Sunday at the community center instead.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sunday at the community center, got it. Thanks for letting me know. Is there anything specific you need help setting up?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Well Hana, I'm not entirely sure about the details yet, but Gus has offered tools and I've asked about the schedule.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it, Eli. Do we know what items people are bringing, or are we just seeing what shows up?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I'm not sure, Hana. I think we might need to ask the organizer for a list of what's needed to avoid duplicates.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Oh, the repair drive is at the community center this Saturday from 10 AM to 4 PM. I hope you can make it!

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, I'll be there. Is there anything specific I should bring?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Bring any small appliances or items that need fixing, and maybe a dish to share for our potluck lunch!

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Oren, what's this about a repair drive? Just the gist, I'm in a rush.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, the repair drive... I think it's this Saturday at the community center, fixing up old electronics? Or was it something else? I'm not entirely sure.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Alright, thanks. I'll check the email later. Catch you around.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Jules told me it's at the community center on Saturday at 10 AM. Should be a good turnout!

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, Vik mentioned it's for electronics too. Sounds like a busy day!

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Oh, electronics too? That's great, I've got an old radio that could use some love.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So Vik, how much do we need to chip in for the lawnmower repair?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh, it's not just lawnmowers! The repair drive this Saturday at the community center is for fixing up old electronics too. Bring your toaster or whatever!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Right, but what's the actual cost for fixing the lawnmower? I need to budget.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Does anyone know if there's a sign-up list for the repair drive? I really don't want to carry my blender over there for nothing.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I'm not sure about a sign-up list, but you could check the community center's bulletin board or ask at the front desk when you drop by.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Good idea, I'll swing by the community center tomorrow and check that bulletin board. Thanks, Jules.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Great! Do you know what time and where exactly we should meet?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: It's at the community center on Saturday from 10 AM to 4 PM. I think they'll take walk-ins.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Perfect, thanks Tess! I'll try to swing by then.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Faye, do you know what this repair drive is all about? I keep hearing about it but still don't get it.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hey Rey! It's a community event to fix up things around the school and neighborhood — like broken playground equipment or classroom furniture. I'm helping coordinate it if you want to join!

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That sounds helpful. What kind of stuff do they need people for?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive? Sorry, I got distracted thinking about something else. What's up with it?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Just wondering if you need help with the drive—I've got my tools ready.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Right, the drive! Yeah, bring your tools over—I'll need all the help I can get.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Dane, great to see you! Just a heads-up, the repair drive got moved to Sunday at the community center instead of Saturday at the porch.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Oh, thanks for the heads up, Rosa! Sunday works for me — I'll be there.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Awesome, Dane! Could you maybe bring some extra tools? I think we'll need more wrenches.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Leo, what's this about a repair drive? I'm in a hurry, just give me the gist.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Neighbors fixing things next Saturday. Need a hand?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Ah, got it. Can't make it, busy. Later.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Nell, I heard you're involved in the repair drive—need me to bring over any tools?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That's kind of you, Gus! I'm still figuring out the details myself. Do you know what time and where we're meeting?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Not sure yet, Nell. But when you find out, count me in. I'll bring my tool kit.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Eli, I just heard the repair drive is fixing electronics too, not just lawnmowers. That's great!

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Well, that's good to know. Do we have a set date for the drive yet? I'd like to put it on my calendar.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, I think it's this Saturday at the community center. Want me to send you the details?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Repair drive? I'm not sure what you're talking about. Are you sure you have the right person?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh sorry, Kira — I must have mixed you up with someone else. It's a community thing to fix up some shared spaces.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: A community thing? I still don't remember hearing about it. Are you sure it's this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Pia! I've been gathering supplies all week for the repair drive. Are you joining us?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, I'd love to, but do we need to sign up ahead of time? I don't want to haul my blender there for nothing.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: No sign-up needed, just show up! I've got a whole list of stuff we're fixing.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Sam, that's really kind. I might take you up on that.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, just let me know whenever you need a hand. I'm around.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I appreciate that, Sam. I'll see if there's something that needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Opal! Have you heard about the neighborhood repair drive this weekend? We're fixing things together—want to join?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, I've heard about it! I'm planning to go. Do you know where exactly it's being held?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great! It's at the community center on Elm Street. Should be fun—see you there!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So Jules, do you know how much we need to chip in for the lawnmower?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, I'm not sure about the exact cost. Maybe check with the organizer at the community center this Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Alright, I'll swing by the community center on Saturday. Thanks for the tip.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Tess, I was thinking about how to get more families involved in the repair drive. Maybe a potluck could help. What do you think?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: A potluck sounds perfect, Mara! I could bring my famous baked beans, and maybe that'll get folks talking about what they need fixed.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, Tess! I'll bring a sign-up sheet for repairs and we can get the word out.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, I'm still trying to understand what it's all about. Can you explain more?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Right, the repair drive—sorry, I keep getting sidetracked. Basically, it's a community fix-it event where people bring broken items and we try to repair them together.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, that sounds interesting. So anyone can bring something to fix?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Oren, have you heard about the neighborhood repair drive this weekend? I'm trying to get a clear list of what needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: A repair drive? Yes, I think I have an old toaster that needs fixing. Or was it a lamp? I can't quite remember...

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you check which one it is? I want to make sure we have the right items on the list.
